bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The biggest story is the Bears' quarterback situation ahead of their Week 3 matchup against the Philadelphia Eagles, as Caleb Williams has already been ruled out for the Chicago Bears' Week 3 action due to a hamstring injury, while backup Tyson Bagent is dealing with a concussion, potentially leaving Case Keenum to start under center. Adding to the QB drama, the Chicago Bears are dealing with some adversity early in the 2026 season after Bears QB Caleb Williams suffered a hamstring injury , though reports indicate he is determined to return ahead of the normal recovery timeline.

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Detroit Lions are gearing up for their Week 3 home matchup against the New York Jets on Sunday, Sept. 27, with the team making roster moves that included placing safety Thomas Harper on Reserve/Injured while elevating DB Jalen Mills and LB Amen Ogbongbemiga from the practice squad .

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The biggest recent storyline out of Green Bay centers on the fallout from the Packers' 35-14 home-opener blowout loss to the Falcons, which has intensified scrutiny on head coach Matt LaFleur and the team's struggling offensive line, while the club also awaits Micah Parsons' eventual return from the PUP list as he continues recovering from his knee injury. The biggest recent story out of Green Bay continues to be fallout from the Packers' lopsided 35-14 home-opener loss to the Falcons, which dropped the team to 1-2 and has put head coach Matt LaFleur under increased scrutiny amid glaring offensive line problems.

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The Vikings enter Week 3 at 2-0, riding a seven-game winning streak, as starting quarterback Kyler Murray returns from the concussion protocol to face Baker Mayfield and the 0-2 Buccaneers in Tampa. Minnesota's defense under Brian Flores has been dominant early, ranking among the league leaders with eight sacks and allowing just 12.5 points per game, setting up a pivotal NFC matchup Sunday afternoon at Raymond James Stadium.
